# Third-party components

Fonts: Geist and Geist Mono (SIL Open Font License, `app/src/main/assets/fonts/OFL-Geist.txt`).
Icons: Material Symbols (Apache-2.0).

Not bundled: Claude Code is the user's own install in Termux (Anthropic's terms). Upstream Buddy's built-in Linux
(proot, talloc, libandroid-shmem) was removed in this fork.
